title: The orbit tensor line bundle descends through a finite invariant-ring quotient
statement: Let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $H$ be a finite group acting by scheme automorphisms $a_h:X\to X$ with $a_h\circ a_g=a_{hg}$, and let $q:X\to Y$ be a finite surjective morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] with $q\circ a_h=q$. Assume that the canonical map of sheaves of rings $\mathcal O_Y\to(q_*\mathcal O_X)^H$ is an isomorphism: for every open $T\subseteq Y$, $\mathcal O_Y(T)$ identifies with the $H$-fixed elements of $\mathcal O_X(q^{-1}T)$, compatibly with restriction. Let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Form $N=\bigotimes_{h\in H}a_h^*L$ using module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Give $N$ its canonical $H$-linearization by permuting the factors: $a_g^*a_h^*L=(a_h\circ a_g)^*L=a_{hg}^*L$, so right multiplication by $g$ reindexes the tensor product, with the canonical pullback, symmetry and associativity isomorphisms. For an open $T\subseteq Y$ let $M(T)=N(q^{-1}T)^H$ with this action; this defines a sheaf of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $M$ is invertible and the canonical evaluation map $q^*M\to N$ is an $H$-equivariant isomorphism, where $q^*M$ has the linearization induced by $q\circ a_h=q$. Moreover, for every integer $d\geq0$ the natural map $M^{\otimes d}\to(q_*(N^{\otimes d}))^H$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules, with tensor power zero meaning the structure sheaf. No freeness of the action, normality or invertibility of $|H|$ is assumed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-per-orbit-tensor-permutation-linearizations] to a, its unit and multiplication equations, q, aq and L. Obtain lin and linPow and retain their four coherence and two orbit-section normalization clauses.

For each y apply [lem-per-orbit-tensor-local-frames]. Its section s yields the explicit orbit frame n and free generators of all powers on q inverse T. Apply the two normalization clauses from the first step to this very s to obtain the fixed-frame hypotheses for lin and linPow.

Apply [lem-per-invariant-frame-line-descent] to F=pencilOrbitBundle a L, lin, linPow, the two ring hypotheses and the local frame witnesses just constructed. Combine its M, j, e and c clauses with the six retained linearization clauses. This is the original conclusion with no change to any hypothesis, transport, tensor power or normalization.
